Definition: properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy)
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Hiphil) to smell, scent, perceive odour, accept; 1a) of horse; 1b) of delight (metaph)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
